description: Source code implementing a traverser for nameless uniform buffer variables in a shader compiler, including logic to assign internal names and replace references within the AST.

classes.name: NameUniformBufferVariablesTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser that assigns internal names to nameless uniform buffer variables and replaces references with indexed access nodes.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Handles declaration nodes, assigns internal names to interface blocks, and updates the map of nameless uniform buffers.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Replaces references to nameless uniform buffer fields with indexed access nodes.
